title: The capability signature is observed in a loaded session, and drift is detected
statement: Once the Kiln package exists, a real Pi run reports its capability signature in the loaded session, and a deliberate change to a measured tool signature causes a comparing consumer to refuse. Both halves are required: presence alone does not show that a consumer would notice its absence.
notes: PASS 2026-09-21 on EVD-0106 and EVD-0122. Presence: a real loaded session calls kiln_capability and receives the shipped declaration (EVD-0106). Drift: real sessions on Windows and Linux, Pi 0.84.4, read every research tool signature from the live registry, and verifyChild accepts the unmodified package and refuses a changed research_fetch as signature-mismatch without returning its output (EVD-0122). CI run 35591168378 at d927151 passed in all four cells, and the live tier re-proved it on ubuntu-latest node 24 only. LIMIT: verifyChild compares property names and the required list only, so a type-only change is not detected and this criterion does not cover one.
